facts.fact: Kai 转身面向 Chloe 强硬消退转平静
facts.anchor: Kai turned back to Chloe, the hardness leaving his frame

facts.fact: Chloe 劝他带 Yna 出去吃饭别再沉默盯着
facts.anchor: She’s a wonderful person, Kai. You should be taking her out to dinner

facts.fact: 更衣室 Yna 脱下翡翠丝绒裙
facts.anchor: the heavy emerald velvet gown slid down Yna’s shoulders

facts.fact: 她换回褪色牛仔裤棉衬衫变回日常
facts.anchor: She pulled on her faded, broken-in denim jeans and a simple cotton blouse

facts.fact: 【转折】她看见两人站水边误以为复合
facts.anchor: Across the open walkway, Kai and Chloe were standing together by the water.

facts.fact: Kai 命 Marcus 拆台归档自己去找 Yna
facts.anchor: Oversee the tear-down and make sure the media footage is logged.

facts.fact: Kai 追到长椅站她面前令她震惊
facts.anchor: Standing over the bench was Kai.
